# The invariants a reading of the tracked text can refuse.
#
# This file is the list. `.github/scripts/check-invariants.sh` is the code that
# applies it and holds no invariant of its own, so adding one is adding a record
# here and nothing else. `docs/invariants.md` argues why the list is data, says
# what this instrument cannot judge, and carries the two invariants that were
# named for this gate and are refused somewhere else or not at all.
#
# One record per invariant, separated by a blank line. Four fields are required
# and a record missing any of them stops the run rather than being skipped:
#
#   Id         the name a refusal prints, so a failure is actionable without
#              reading the checker
#   Files      space-separated shell globs, matched against the tracked path.
#              An invariant says what it reads; nothing is scanned by default
#   Prevents   the failure this refuses, in one sentence
#   Pattern    an extended regular expression, handed to `grep -nE` unchanged
#
# And one optional field, which may appear more than once in a record:
#
#   Except     a tracked path prefix, then a space, then the reason it is
#              excepted. A prefix matching nothing tracked is refused, so an
#              exception cannot outlive the file it was written for, and an
#              exception with no reason is refused as well.
#
# Every record here has a leg in `.github/scripts/prove-invariants.sh` that
# plants exactly its violation and requires this checker to refuse that id and no
# other, and a neighbouring leg that changes the one thing back and requires no
# refusal at all.

Id: host-font-path
Files: *.rs *.toml *.sh *.yml *.yaml
Prevents: A rendering that depends on what happens to be installed on the machine that produced it, which makes every fidelity number a number about that machine.
Pattern: /usr/share/fonts|/usr/local/share/fonts|/etc/fonts|/System/Library/Fonts|/Library/Fonts|[Ww]indows\\+[Ff]onts|fontconfig|fc-list|fc-match|SystemSource|load_system_fonts
Except: .github/scripts/prove-invariants.sh the file that plants this violation in a scratch tree and requires the refusal, which cannot do so without naming the directory

Id: network-outside-host
Files: *.rs
Prevents: A component on the parsing side of the input boundary reaching the network, which turns a malformed document into somebody else's problem instead of a parse error.
Pattern: std::net|TcpStream|TcpListener|UdpSocket|to_socket_addrs|reqwest|ureq|isahc|curl::|hyper::client
Except: crates/host/ the component the input boundary declares as the one that may hold the filesystem, the network and the clock

Id: secret-in-a-plain-string
Files: *.rs
Prevents: A credential in a type whose Debug and Display print it, which is how a secret reaches a log, a panic message or a bug report without anybody deciding that it should.
Pattern: (password|passphrase|secret|credential|api_key|apikey|private_key|[a-z_]+_token)[a-z_]*[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*(String|&str|Option<String>|Option<&str>)

Id: absolute-path-in-a-test
Files: */tests/*.rs tests/*.rs
Prevents: A test that passes on the machine it was written on and fails everywhere else, and one that writes outside the directory it created.
Pattern: "/[A-Za-z]|"[A-Za-z]:\\
